label: Command Center — OPC UA Server
info:
Command Center OPC UA Server.

Namespace ns=1
Variables per line (LINE-01 / LINE-02 / LINE-03):
  - <Line>.Request  (String, writable=false from clients — server only)
  - <Line>.Ack      (String, writable=true  — clients write back here)

Clients (line-das) connect via:
  opc.tcp://command-center:5160/UA/CommandCenter
(factory-net only — not exposed to host)

This flow only sets up the address space + emits debug on Ack writes.
DB integration is handled by Picker (PR13) and AckHandler (PR14) flows.
